What are the benefits of using ORM

Some common ORM frameworks include Hibernate (for Java), Django ORM (for Python), Entity Framework (for .NET), SQLAlchemy (for Python), and ActiveRecord (for Ruby on Rails).
How does ORM work
ORM works by creating a mapping between the objects in the application and the database tables. When an object is created or modified, the ORM framework translates these changes into SQL queries that are executed against the database. This allows developers to interact with the database using object-oriented concepts rather than writing SQL.
